sub_service: Garbage/sanitation complaint via Municipal Corporation Chandigarh's general contact channel
problem_type: Uncollected garbage, solid waste management issues
description: MCC's own live 'Complaints' page (mcchandigarh.gov.in/?q=complaints) and its separate 'Grievance.aspx' page were both fetched directly (twice, the second time asking for verbatim raw text to guard against a misread). Both name the same real general contact channel: a toll-free number ('Tollfree no. for complaints 14420 (8 AM to 8 PM)'), a direct MCC line (0172-2787200, labelled 'For Complaints related to MCC Services'), and an email (comm-mcc-chd@nic.in). The Complaints page separately lists SWM (solid waste management) rules/Supreme Court compliance documents, confirming Waste & Sanitation is a service area MCC actively administers, but neither page gives a category-specific SLA or a dedicated waste-only contact -- both channels are general, covering every service category alike.
procedure: Call the toll-free number (14420, 8 AM-8 PM) or the direct MCC complaints line (0172-2787200), or email comm-mcc-chd@nic.in, or use the Complaint/Suggestion web form on mcchandigarh.gov.in; the source pages offer no category-specific routing beyond this general contact.
